svg.title: Paths through one clip.
svg.desc: TopView_1A: 160 of 965 track IDs, selected at evenly spaced indices from ascending ID order. Up to 80 frame-ordered positions per displayed track. Local x and y coordinates in metres use an equal scale. Green dots mark the first recorded position of each displayed track, not entry points.
svg.text: TOPVIEW_1A / 160 OF 965 TRACK IDs / EQUAL-SCALE LOCAL COORDINATES
Deterministic subset / max. 80 positions per track / 355,206 source rows
